Makeup can do more than just change your appearan臼. [ 9 ] 1t can also alter others' perceptions of you , for better

perceive women who wear makeup as being of a higher status , men associate makeup with prestigious positive qualities , 
while women view other women wearing makeup a♀ bein g dominant and a potential threat. 
[ 10] The research showed that men and women both rated the faces with cosmetics as being more attractive , but 
only women rated made-up faces as being more dominant , while only men rated made-up faces as being higher in

female jealousy seemed to be the main cause for the differences i n p erception. Women rating women with makeup said

coun阳patts . Cosmetic products are good for more than just giving you a pretty face. It can be palticularly useful for

women might influence a female candi date's decision about wearing makeup. Whether the interviewer s wil1 view her as

Autonomous cars that can take over from drivers if they are tired or caught in the heat of an argument are being 
developed in Sweden. [ 22 J Researchers working as part of the European Union's 87 billion research program are 
developing sensor-based systems that monitor whether a dri ver is distracted , anxious or t让ed . If a dri ver is not in a fït 
state to be on the road , the car automatically takes control of the wheel to prevent accidents. Dr. Anna Anund from the 
Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute , who is leading the pr可 ect ， said a dri ver' s state can be 
measur ed using a number of sensors , including heart rate monitor s and eye sensors , which track where a driver's gaze 
is. [23 J She said the aim wasωreally make sure that the transition from the driver ωthe vehicle is done in a safe way , 
so we can take into consideration the driver's state l_ and so we do not give control to a driver who is under pressure of 
fatigue , stress , anxiety , and so on. 
According to data from the European Commission , Sweden has the safest roads in the EU , with the UK a close 
secon d. However , the number of road accidents in both has largely leveled out since 2010. [ 24 J Dri ver fatig ue is 
thought to be responsible for as many as a tìfth of road crashe s across 由e EU . Although there are certain times of the day 
when more accidents happen - at 6 创n ， for exampl e , drivers are said to be 20 times more likely to have an accident than 
at 10 am. While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term , 
some have questioned whether it is safe. The researchers have said the technology they are developing is seeking ω 
bridge the gap between Level 3 on the autonomy scale in which dli vers have to be ready to take control of the car at any 
point , and Level 4 in which driving is automated. 
Daniel Ruiz , the chief executive of the UK' s Connected and Autonomous Vehicle Progr am Meridian , said there is 
a strong debate going on about how it is possibl e to make a Level 3 car completely safe. 
Despite advances in technology , we still have some way to go in shifting public sentimen t. [ 25 J With an increase 
in attention -grabbing accidents recently , drivers now view self-dliving cars as less safe than they used to.

questions.source_explanation: 答案为 A) 。 句 [ 24 ]提到，驾驶员疲劳被认为是导致欧盟范围内多达五分之一交通事故的原因 。 A) 项是对录音中 Oriver fatigue 的原词复现，故为答案 。 |
questions.distractor_analysis: 干扰项排除 I B ) 项中的"糟糕的交通状况"在录音中未提及，故排除 ;C) 项中的"酒后驾驶"在录音中未提 及，故排除;录音中虽然提到早上 6 点发生事故的概率是上午 10 点的 2 0 倍，但这只是说明疲劳高发的时间段，并 不是说 0 ) 项中的"驾驶时间"导致了五分之一的事故，故排除 。

questions.source_explanation: 答案为 C) 。 句 [ 药 ]提到，随着近期引 人关注 的交通事故频发，如今驾驶员普遍认为 自动驾驶汽车的 安全性低于以往水平 。 C) 项是对录音中 Wi出 an increase in attention -grabbing accidents recently 的同义转述，故为 答案 。 |
questions.distractor_analysis: 干扰项排除 I A) 项是根据录音中 stron g debate 和 Level3 car 设置的干扰项 ，录 音中说的是专家提到对三级 汽车 的安全性有激烈辩论，但这只是背景信息，并非导致公众觉得"自动驾驶汽车比过去不安全"的 直接原因，故 排除 ; 录音中明确提到技术取得了进步 (advances) ，而不是 B) 项中的"没有显著的进步 "，故排除 ;0) 项是根据录 音中 s ome way to go in shifting public sentiment 设置的干扰项，但录音中说的是改变公众情绪方面还有很长的路 要走，并非是说"可行的方法很少 "，故排除 。
